rationale: P identifies braking behavior when braking is required, which must be characterised to evaluate whether required maneuvers are omitted. SG-1 and FR-7 establish braking itself as the behavior of interest, while H-1 supports the collision-avoidance context and pedestrian scenario. P does not extend into sensing, computation, communication, controller internals, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: "Vehicle braking behavior" is legitimately included because the target concerns omission of that behavior, and FR-7 explicitly requires braking maneuvers.
"Situations where a braking maneuver is required to avoid a collision" bounds P to the circumstances relevant to SG-1 and H-1.
The scope includes obstacles and road users, including the pedestrian crossing 20 m ahead, as supported by H-1 and FR-7.
The declared scope does not incorporate supporting mechanisms merely because they affect braking.
